- **C2 — operability: capability acquisition `origin-tip-drift`.** Instrument `scripts/proxy-check.mjs` (contract `kumitate-proxy-v1`, one additive mode `--tip-drift [--origin DIR]`). Base: `--tip-drift` is an unknown argument, exit 64. Live world: pin `31c465f15669…`, origin `fb7157fcf146…`, 58 commits / 241 changed paths (57 script-layer, 23 runtime-layer, 161 other).
The frozen predicate sentences, kill rules and pre-registered scores are in plan.md §C1/§C2; they are the same sentences the L1 will measure and the report will carry. Do not re-word them.

# Hard rules for every seat
- **Scratch only for work trees.** Every clone, fixture, mirror, counter `--work` dir and mutant tree lives under `$HYAKU_SCRATCH/kumitate-r75/<your seat name>/` with `HYAKU_SCRATCH` defaulting to `/fast/scratch/hyaku` (NVMe). `mkdir -p` it, pass it explicitly (`TMPDIR=…`, `mkdtemp(dir=…)`), never rely on an inherited TMPDIR, never hardcode `/tmp` in anything you write. `/tmp` is only for files under 50 MB. The L1 is the only writer; seats return patches, drafts and receipts.
- **Fixture repos**: create them as `D=$(mktemp -d)` (under your scratch), `git -C "$D" init -q`, and name `-C "$D"` on every later git call; verify `git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals `$D` before the first commit. Never commit with a throwaway identity anywhere else.
- **Write scope**: your scratch dir, plus artifacts under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-75/build/<your seat name>/ (the L1 commits those as wave evidence). Never edit the lane tree's tracked files: code changes are delivered as a `.patch` plus receipts; prose changes (note, lesson, SCORECARD, LOG) as draft files under build/. Never touch /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin (fleet root), any sibling lane repo, `.ufo/state/`, `.scratch/`, MANIFEST.json, `templates/`, `scripts/` of the fleet, or `/home/vgpnk/Projects/ufo-fsd-alpha` (read-only origin; every read is read-only).

# Seat — K75ExecTipDrift
/skill:godspeed

# Target
Claim C2's mechanism: add the `--tip-drift [--origin DIR]` mode to `scripts/proxy-check.mjs` (contract `kumitate-proxy-v1`, additive; default mode unchanged) with hermetic selftest arms. Work in a scratch clone of the lane at `c38382d547a1ec21bb7f51b4c08ef08053e7abae`; deliver a patch + receipts.

# Change (exact requirements — the frozen predicate in plan.md §C2 measures these strings and exit codes)
1. Scratch clone as in the other executor seat, under `$HYAKU_SCRATCH/kumitate-r75/K75ExecTipDrift/`; edit only `scripts/proxy-check.mjs`.
2. New mode, parsed in the existing argument loop (never after `--selftest`):
   `<pin rev>` from the pin file (`--pin`, default `<self>/.ufo/pins/origin.json`; a missing default pin is `PIN_MALFORMED` exit 2 in this mode — the mode is meaningless unpinned).
   `<origin>` = `--origin DIR`, else `$UFO_ORIGIN`, else the existing legacy candidate list (`~/Projects/ufo-fsd-alpha`, `~/Projects/origin-work/ufo-fsd-alpha`, first existing). Non-directory or not a git repo / HEAD not 40 hex → `ORIGIN_TIP_DRIFT: FAIL-CLOSED SRC_REV_UNVERIFIABLE <dir>` exit 2.
   Equality: `git -C <origin> rev-parse HEAD` — this is read-only (`GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`).
3. Output: exactly one stdout line, the last line, one of:
   `ORIGIN_TIP_DRIFT: IN_SYNC pin=<12> origin=<12> commits=0 changed=0 scripts=0 runtime=0 other=0` exit **0**
   `ORIGIN_TIP_DRIFT: MOVED pin=<12> origin=<12> commits=<n> changed=<n> scripts=<n> runtime=<n> other=<n>` exit **1**
   `ORIGIN_TIP_DRIFT: FAIL-CLOSED <TOKEN> <detail>` exit **2**
   `commits` = `git -C <origin> rev-list --count <pin>..<originHead>`; `changed` = number of paths in `git -C <origin> diff --name-only <pin> <originHead>`; the three classes use the proxy's own frozen layer predicates: script = `^scripts/[^/]+\.mjs$` or `^scripts/.+/`; runtime = `^crates/ufo-core-runtime/src/[^/]+\.rs$` or `^crates/ufo-cli/src/[^/]+\.rs$`; other = the rest. `pin=<12>` / `origin=<12>` are the first 12 hex of each revision.
   `--json` with `--tip-drift` prints one JSON object `{mode:"tip-drift", status:"MOVED|IN_SYNC|FAIL-CLOSED", pin, origin, commits, changed, scripts, runtime, other}` instead; `--strict` has no effect on this mode.
4. Keep the usage text current: the USAGE must name `--tip-drift` and `--origin DIR`, and `-h` must still exit 0. An unknown flag stays exit 64.
5. Selftest arms (hermetic temp repos under `mkdtemp`, `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1` `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null` and a tmp `HOME`, as the existing pin fixtures do): (i) in-sync — a temp repo whose HEAD is written into a temp pin file → IN_SYNC exit 0; (ii) moved — one more commit in the temp repo → MOVED with `commits=1` and the right class counts, exit 1; (iii) non-git dir → FAIL-CLOSED exit 2; (iv) malformed `--pin` → exit 2; (v) `-h` names the mode. Keep 124 existing cases green; each new arm must fail when its own branch is removed.
6. Receipts into `.ufo/waves/round-75/build/K75ExecTipDrift/`: `K75ExecTipDrift.patch`, `red-before.txt` (selftest base `124/124`, `--tip-drift` → exit 64), `after-selftest.txt` (`PROXY_SELFTEST: <n>/<n> pass`, n ≥ 127), `live-tip-drift.txt` — the real run from the clone: `node scripts/proxy-check.mjs --tip-drift` → the MOVED line with `commits=58 changed=241 scripts=57 runtime=23 other=161` exit 1, plus `--tip-drift --origin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kumitate-pin/src` → IN_SYNC exit 0, plus `--origin /tmp` (a non-git dir) → FAIL-CLOSED exit 2. Record `echo exit=$?` for each.
7. Limits: never change a default-mode term, the stanza keys or the exit map; never touch `SCORECARD.md`; the pin file stays byte-identical.
